description: Add photos to a regular collection; a smart collection is refused. Returns added (the photos that were not members and are now) and already_in_collection (ids of photos that were members already, left as they were); unknown IDs are not_found.

collection_name.description: Collection path from list_collections, or a bare name. A listed path always picks that collection; a bare name of a nested collection must be unique.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths

name: add_to_collection
title: Add to collection
